items.title: Taaruf: qualitative aur quantitative tajziya (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the unnumbered introduction, printed page 323.

blocks.text: Analytical chemistry woh science hai jo chemicals ki pehchan (characterization) karti hai. Kisi compound ki poori pehchan mein do qism ka analysis (jaanch) shamil hai: qualitative aur quantitative. Qualitative analysis mein chemist yeh dhoondta hai ke compound mein kaun se elements maujood hain. Quantitative analysis mein yeh maloom kiya jata hai ke har element kitni miqdar (amount) mein hai.
Poora quantitative analysis aam taur par chaar bare qadmon (steps) mein hota hai:

items: Jis cheez ko naapna hai (desired constituent) use baqi cheezon se alag karna
Measurement (naap) karna aur result ka hisab lagana

blocks.text: Is chapter mein kuch bunyadi separation techniques (alag karne ke tareeqe) bataye gaye hain jo lab mein practice ki jati hain.

blocks.caption: Analysis ki do qismein
header: Kis sawal ka jawab deta hai
rows: kaun se elements (ya madde) maujood hain?
har ek kitni miqdar mein hai?

blocks.prompt: Ek student safed powder ko flame test aur precipitation reactions se check karta hai, phir us ka tola hua sample titrate karta hai. Kaun sa hissa qualitative hai aur kaun sa quantitative?
blocks.explanation: Flame test aur precipitation reactions batate hain ke powder mein kya hai: yeh qualitative analysis hai. Sample tolna aur titrate karna batata hai ke koi cheez kitni hai: yeh quantitative analysis hai, jo chaar qadmon par chalta hai: sample, alag karna, naap aur hisab, nateeja.

items: Qualitative analysis: kya maujood hai. Quantitative analysis: kitna maujood hai.
Quantitative analysis ke chaar qadam: sample lena, alag karna, naap aur hisab, nateeja nikalna.
